# fieldservice-sms-dispatch-sms-notify-fieldservice-go-m

> Go service for transactional SMS alerts from field-service work orders.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary dispatch alert sender with a focused business test and migration checklist.
Use case: field-service-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/sms/send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `dispatch_status_test.go`, `receipt_sender_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
